name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Tree.universal_key
title: Tree encodings: the decomposed-LWE sample z = s^T Z + e is a universal constrained key
statement: Over a commutative ring, if G X - f G = Z H (the key equation (24) of Tree Encodings I at one input alpha, with X = M_f P_alpha), then for every secret s and noise e, (s^T Z + e) H = s^T (G X) - f (s^T G) + e H. So the single statement- and input-independent sample z = s^T Z + e evaluates, for every bounded-depth f and every alpha, the master value s^T G M_f P_alpha up to the offset f(alpha) s^T G: the shape of a BV15 constrained key, here without any attribute.
